Family Offer: Use promo code EARLYBIRD to get 4 tickets for £80 for Band A-C on all performances. Offer ends 30 September!

Come to Islington, where the streets are paved with gold…

Dick Whittington’s adventure begins when he journeys to London town to find fame and fortune, with his trusty cat in tow. But with rats running riot, the big city doesn’t quite match up to his dreams... Can our young hero save Islington from the Rat King’s clutches, and restore London to its former glory? And will he find love along the way?

Back for its third year, North London’s favourite panto is sure to bring festive cheer for all the family. With show-stopping musical numbers, toe-tapping tunes, and a whole lotta laughs, this is a theatrical delight you won’t want to miss. 

RuPaul’s Drag Race UK favourites River Medway and Victoria Scone will star in both productions, with Victoria returning to the theatre as ‘Dragpuss’, following her appearance as ‘Dame Trott’ in last year’s Jack and the Beanstalk, and River making her King’s Head Theatre debut as ‘Queen Rat’. 

And there’s more! We couldn’t do the innuendo-filled Dick Whittington without bringing back our hit Adults Only shows, complete with drag and West End guest stars! With previous guest stars including John Owen Jones, Kate Butch, Steven Webb, and Christina Bianco, this is your chance to see your faves live on stage.

Contact boxoffice@kingsheadtheatre.com or call 0207 226 8561 to book tickets.

YOUR VISIT

Age Guidance: All ages welcome! Children under 3 go free! No ticket required when they sit on a ticketed grown up's lap. No individual seat provided.

Runtime: TBC (Approx 2h)

Latecomers Policy: Starting times for this show vary. Please ensure you arrive at the venue with plenty of time. Latecomers may only enter at a specific point.

Opening Times: Our bar and box office are open from 45 minutes before the performance starts.

We want to ensure everyone can enjoy a show at King's Head Theatre. By joining our membership or access programmes, you can receive exclusive offers to this and many more shows at KHT:

  • Access Scheme: 15% off any Band B, C or D tickets and, where needed, a free essential companion. Join today, and your discount will automatically apply after approval and when you're logged in.
  • KHT Club: For just £60 per year, Club Members are always able to book a Band A ticket to all shows for £25, or 2x tickets if they’re a Joint Club Member. Join today, and the discount will automatically apply when you log in.
  • Under 35s Membership: £10 Preview Tickets (on selected performances) & £15 Band B, C or D for selected performances. Join today, and your discount will automatically apply after approval and when you're logged in.
  • N1 Workers & Residents: £10 Preview Tickets. Join today, and your discount will automatically apply after approval and when you're logged in.
  • KHT Artists Club: £10 Preview Tickets & £15 Band B, C or D on selected performances. Join today, and your discount will automatically apply after approval and when you're logged in.
  • Multi-buy: Coming to multiple shows at King's Head Theatre? Receive 10% off if you book 2 shows, 15% off 3 shows or 20% off 4+ shows if booked in one transaction. 

You must be logged in to your account on the website to access your members only rewards and offers. If you have any issues, please contact boxoffice@kingsheadtheatre.com and we'd be happy to help!
